title: User and Permissions Management in the Admin Panel
summary: Centralize and streamline organization administration with a new UI for managing users, groups, and roles. Org admins can now easily assign members to specific workspaces, create groups to bulk-assign permissions, and navigate organization settings in one place, significantly reducing the overhead of managing large teams.
whatsNew: Centralize and streamline organization administration with a new UI for managing users, groups, and roles. Org admins can now easily assign members to specific workspaces, create groups to bulk-assign permissions, and navigate organization settings in one place, significantly reducing the overhead of managing large teams.
keyCapabilities: Dedicated admin dashboard to manage organization settings, members, workspaces, and API keys without navigating back to Studio.
Group management to create, update, and delete groups, including the ability to bulk add or remove users and assign groups to specific workspaces.
Workspace creation and management allowing admins to assign members and roles directly upon creation, and a detail view to manage workspace permissions, limits, and associated groups.
User detail views providing a comprehensive overview of each user's workspace associations, group memberships, and role grants.
App switcher enhancements allowing workspace admins and users with relevant roles to easily access admin settings directly from other Mistral applications.
